notes: Arrow flight (mw-e29.11), the plain arrow's own trail cue and the one noise and blunt arrows share: a few pale motes shed along the flight so a shot reads as it crosses the room. The ribbon behind the shaft (src/game/vfx trail-controller) does the streak; this only adds grain. Plays while the arrow flies and stops at its first impact. Style bible §8: alpha-blended, small, no flashing.
